items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 26:1
items.html: Because the ten Sefirot of the Rosh of Atik came out there in their place, namely from the Peh of the Rosh of Nekudim and upward to the Tabur of AK, and this level illuminates all of GAR of Nekudim standing there, hence Atik is considered to have taken the GAR of Hochma and Bina. However, from the phase of Bina, it also took Hesed, because as long as there is no expansion of Bina into ZAT, the light of Hesed is found standing in GAR of Bina. (Inner Light, page 626, Sub Header, “And Also”)
